title: Changing to the customer that was the picked Bill To makes it self-billed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, that bills itself.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer D, picked by hand as the payer, that bills itself.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Estimate, billed to customer D, where customer D was picked on the Customer card.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Expand the Customer card.
  3. Click Change Customer (the two arrows at the top right of the Customer card).
  4. Pick customer D.
  5. Confirm the change.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • The Customer card's "Bill To" field reads customer D's name.

Step 3:

  • The customer picker opens.

Step 4:

  • Customer D is picked.

Step 5:

  • The work order's customer is customer D.
  • "Bill To" reads "This customer".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)
